curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_DELTA_KEY" \\ https://api.yourservice.com/comments?domain=apple.com``` | | 2 | **Add any optional filters** – e.g., limit, offset, sort order. | ```bash
curl -G https://api.yourservice.com/comments \ --data-urlencode "domain=apple.com" \ --data-urlencode "limit=50" \ --data-urlencode "sort=desc" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_DELTA_KEY"``` | | 3 | **Handle pagination** – many APIs return a `next_page_token`. Keep requesting until it’s empty. | ```python
import requests

token = None
while True:
params = {"domain": "apple.com"}
if token:
params["page_token"] = token
r = requests.get("https://api.yourservice.com/comments", params=params, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {YOUR_DELTA_KEY}"})
data = r.json()
process(data["items"])
token = data.get("next_page_token")
if not token:
